form.label: Cisco Switch Overview
form.description: نمای کلی وضعیت دریافت لاگ، پوشش تجهیزات و سطح Severity مشاهده‌شده در سوئیچ‌های Cisco

search.query: index=`cisco_index` | eval device=coalesce(dvc,host,source) | where isnotnull(device) | stats count by device | sort 0 device
index=`cisco_index` | eval device=coalesce(dvc,host) | search device="$tok_device$" | stats dc(device) as count
index=`cisco_index` earliest=-15m | eval device=coalesce(dvc,host) | search device="$tok_device$" | stats dc(device) as count

index=`cisco_index` earliest=-7d@d | eval device=coalesce(dvc,host) | search device="$tok_device$" | stats latest(_time) as last_seen by device | where last_seen < relative_time(now(),"-24h") | stats count

single.option: فعال در ۷ روز، بدون لاگ در ۲۴ ساعت

search.query: index=`cisco_index` | eval device=coalesce(dvc,host,source) | search device="$tok_device$" | stats count

html.div: هدف: بررسی روند دریافت لاگ و مشخص‌شدن افت یا جهش ناگهانی در حجم داده Cisco.

search.query: index=`cisco_index` | eval device=coalesce(dvc,host,source) | search device="$tok_device$" | timechart span=30m count as events

html.div: هدف: وضعیت onboarding هر سوئیچ، آخرین زمان دریافت لاگ و کیفیت استخراج فیلدها را یکجا نشان می‌دهد. بررسی: تجهیزات Silent، درصد پایین فیلدهای Severity/Mnemonic و تفاوت غیرعادی حجم لاگ بین سوئیچ‌ها بررسی شود.

search.query:
index=`cisco_index` | eval device=coalesce(dvc,host,source), has_severity=if(isnotnull(severity_id) OR isnotnull(severity_name),1,0), has_mnemonic=if(isnotnull(mnemonic),1,0), has_message=if(isnotnull(message_text),1,0) | search device="$tok_device$" | stats count as Events latest(_time) as LastSeen by device | eval Status=case(LastSeen>=relative_time(now(),"-6h"),"Active",LastSeen>=relative_time(now(),"-48h"),"Delayed",true(),"Silent")
| convert ctime(LastSeen) | rename device as Switch | table Switch Status LastSeen Events | sort 0 Status Switch

html.div: هدف: مشخص‌کردن Severityهایی که عملاً از هر سوئیچ دریافت شده‌اند. نکته: «عمیق‌ترین سطح مشاهده‌شده» از روی رویدادهای موجود محاسبه می‌شود و لزوماً برابر مقدار تنظیم‌شده در دستور logging trap نیست.

table.title: سطح لاگ‌گیری مشاهده‌شده برای هر سوئیچ

search.query: index=`cisco_index` | eval device=coalesce(dvc,host,source), sev=tonumber(severity_id) | search device="$tok_device$" sev>=0 sev<=7 | stats count as Events min(sev) as MostSevere max(sev) as DeepestObserved values(severity_id_and_name) as ObservedLevels by device | eval MostSevereName=case(MostSevere=0,"0 - Emergency",MostSevere=1,"1 - Alert",MostSevere=2,"2 - Critical",MostSevere=3,"3 - Error",MostSevere=4,"4 - Warning",MostSevere=5,"5 - Notice",MostSevere=6,"6 - Informational",MostSevere=7,"7 - Debug") | eval DeepestObservedName=case(DeepestObserved=0,"0 - Emergency",DeepestObserved=1,"1 - Alert",DeepestObserved=2,"2 - Critical",DeepestObserved=3,"3 - Error",DeepestObserved=4,"4 - Warning",DeepestObserved=5,"5 - Notice",DeepestObserved=6,"6 - Informational",DeepestObserved=7,"7 - Debug") | rename device as Switch | table Switch MostSevereName DeepestObservedName ObservedLevels Events | sort 0 DeepestObserved Switch

html.div: هدف: مقایسه توزیع Severity بین سوئیچ‌ها و شناسایی تجهیزاتی که فقط بخشی از سطوح را ارسال می‌کنند.

search.query: index=`cisco_index` | eval device=coalesce(dvc,host,source), sev=tonumber(severity_id) | search device="$tok_device$" sev>=0 sev<=7 | eval Severity=case(sev=0,"0-Emergency",sev=1,"1-Alert",sev=2,"2-Critical",sev=3,"3-Error",sev=4,"4-Warning",sev=5,"5-Notice",sev=6,"6-Informational",sev=7,"7-Debug") | chart count over device by Severity limit=0

html.div: هدف: بررسی اینکه داده‌های هر sourcetype تا چه حد فیلدهای اصلی Cisco را استخراج کرده‌اند.

table.title: کیفیت Field Extraction به تفکیک Sourcetype

search.query: index=`cisco_index` | eval device=coalesce(dvc,host,source), has_severity=if(isnotnull(severity_id),1,0), has_facility=if(isnotnull(facility),1,0), has_mnemonic=if(isnotnull(mnemonic),1,0), has_message=if(isnotnull(message_text),1,0) | search device="$tok_device$" | stats count as Events sum(has_severity) as sev sum(has_facility) as fac sum(has_mnemonic) as mne sum(has_message) as msg dc(device) as Switches by sourcetype | eval Severity=round(100*sev/Events,1)."%", Facility=round(100*fac/Events,1)."%", Mnemonic=round(100*mne/Events,1)."%", Message=round(100*msg/Events,1)."%" | table sourcetype Switches Events Severity Facility Mnemonic Message | sort 0 - Events

html.div: بررسی: سوئیچ‌هایی که در هفت روز گذشته لاگ داشته‌اند ولی در ۲۴ ساعت اخیر Silent شده‌اند.

search.query: index=`cisco_index` earliest=-7d@d | eval device=coalesce(dvc,host,source) | search device="$tok_device$" | stats latest(_time) as LastSeen count as Events values(source) as Sources values(sourcetype) as Sourcetypes by device | where LastSeen < relative_time(now(),"-24h") | eval SilenceDuration=tostring(now()-LastSeen,"duration") | convert ctime(LastSeen) | rename device as Switch | table Switch LastSeen SilenceDuration Events Sources Sourcetypes | sort 0 LastSeen
